name: National Safety Counsel
desc:
Customer Service Representative | $19.75 to $20.75/hr | Inbound and Some Outbound, Phone, Chat, and Email, No Sales Expected
Company: National Safety Council
Industry: Customer Service

What Your Day Will Look Like:
The National Safety Council is a nonprofit that works to prevent injuries and deaths at work and everywhere else. In this full-time remote role, you help customers by phone, chat, and email, and you often handle more than one conversation at a time. You look up answers in job aids and training materials, walk people through program details and eLearning platforms, and help with LMS issues like access codes, password resets, account lockouts, and certificate reprints. You enter and update customer information in several systems, document every contact, and take live credit card payments following PII and PCI security rules. You also make outbound calls to finish registrations or fix account issues, flag repeat problems to management, and help update team resources.

Soft Skills
- Clear verbal and written communication
- Empathy and active listening
- Problem solving
- Staying calm with upset customers
- Attention to detail
assessment: Yes. The posting states the hiring process starts with an assessment designed to showcase your drive for the role, followed by two rounds of interviews.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED
Required Experience: 1 to 2 years of customer service experience in a contact center, service setting, or similar role with direct customer contact
Preferred Experience: Using multiple computer systems, web-based programs, or a learning management system (LMS). Handling phone, chat, and email in a fast-paced setting. Processing secure payments or working with sensitive data (PII and PCI) is a plus. Bilingual in English and Spanish is ideal and pays more.

Required Skills:
- Strong verbal and written communication
- Active listening and empathy
- Problem solving and sound decisions within set guidelines
- Accurate data entry and documentation
- Comfortable switching between several systems

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has contact center or customer service experience
- Is bilingual in English and Spanish
- Stays patient and kind with frustrated customers
- Likes learning new systems and following step by step guides

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no customer service experience
- Does not like handling phone, chat, and email at the same time
- Struggles with accurate data entry and documenting every contact
- Is not comfortable handling payment information securely
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Complete an assessment where you show your drive for the role
3. First interview about your skills and how you fit with the team
4. Second interview that goes deeper into your background and what you can contribute
5. Final decision
This is the process listed in the posting.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Customer service
- Contact center
- Phone, chat, and email support
- Data entry
- Documentation
- Learning management system (LMS)
- Troubleshooting
- Active listening
- Payment processing (PCI)
- Bilingual English and Spanish

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Why do you want to work for a safety-focused nonprofit like NSC?
- How do you keep track of details when you switch between several systems?
- A customer is upset because they are locked out of their course. How do you handle it?
- Tell us about a time you calmed down an upset customer. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you had to handle several tasks at once. What happened, how did you prioritize, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $19.75/hr English only, $20.75/hr Bilingual (English and Spanish)
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage
-Benefits: At least 20 PTO days accrued in the first year and 11 paid holidays, flexible work arrangements, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, flex spending accounts for medical and dependent care, 403(b) and Roth 403(b) with employer match up to 6%, and reimbursable training
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: Full-time remote. The posting says bilingual is ideal, and bilingual pay is $1 more an hour. Phone, chat, and email all count, so participants should be comfortable on calls. The role takes live credit card payments, so a careful, trustworthy handling of customer data matters. NSC is a Recovery-Friendly Workplace that supports people in or seeking recovery from substance use. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Customer Operations Team Lead → Customer Experience Manager. This role builds customer support, LMS and system skills, secure payment handling, and process improvement.
